title: dactylorhiza praetermissa subsp. junialis
intro: Dactylorhiza praetermissa subsp. junialis, commonly known as Juniper Banded Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to the UK and other parts of Europe. It is a type of terrestrial orchid that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Juniper Banded Orchid include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
